scope: Fixed-corpus solver regression only; Koblitz y^2+xy=x^3+x^2+1. Not uniform-target yield, a full ECDLP, or a general binary/prime-field benchmark.
correctness_gate: Every process completes and every SAT witness passes ANF and S4 checks. SAT on a target that lifts must verify as a point relation. The named non-lifting target is an algebraic-only rejection control and must never count as a point relation. Every distinct UNSAT case has a complete exhaustive S4 check. No errors, timeouts or missing cases.
repeatability_gate: Same binary and configuration must reproduce status and conflict count on every repetition.
comparison: Require identical contract, corpus, runner, checker and repetition slots. Report each configuration against its frozen baseline. No change to counter meaning is permitted.
stage_counter_candidate_target: At least 20 percent lower sum of per-case median conflicts, with no case more than 10 percent worse; this is a solver-counter diagnostic, never an operation-normalized speedup claim.
time_policy: Secondary only. Report per-case medians and p90. Baseline/candidate timing ratios are interpretable only on matched hosts, with contention and compiler differences disclosed.
primary_metric: Full-DLP S = total calibrated common operations / sqrt(subgroup order), plus ratios to matched rho and applicable floor. Unmeasured in this suite; all such fields remain null.
counting_boundary: p_dec <= min(1,binom(M+m-1,m)/N) for uniform targets; it does not estimate success on this selected corpus.
exponent_policy: No exponent fit to three field degrees and a selected SAT/UNSAT corpus.
revision_reason: The v1 strict point-only batch found that n19l6-19-U has algebraic roots but its target x does not lift. Preserve the failed v1 batch and explicitly freeze that case as a negative point-relation control before the v2 run.
